svg.aria-label: The path every change takes across four repositories: a Lavish review artifact is written before the code, the branch is built and linted, the no-mistakes gate reviews it, then it merges and deploys. Sixty-nine review artifacts, fifty-two merged pull requests and forty-nine gate commits stand behind those four repositories.
svg.title: Plan in the open, gate before merge: 69 artifacts, 52 PRs, 49 gate commits

g.title: step 1 · plan — a Lavish HTML artifact states the change and its open decisions before any code exists; 69 of them across the four repositories
step 2 · build on a branch — conventional commits, and a lint that encodes the page contract rather than describing it
step 3 · the no-mistakes gate — an adversarial review that pushes its own branch and lands as a no-mistakes(...) commit; 49 of them so far
step 4 · merge and deploy — 52 merged pull requests; in every one of these systems, merging to main is the deploy
the gate is the only step that can send work backwards, and it is the step that is not optional
g.text: the only step that sends work back

g.title: counted on 2026-08-30 across ConvFinQA-agent, data-qa-agent, transcript-rag-agent and this site
